title: Will North Korean forces bolster Russia's Ukraine war?
text: Conflicts Ukraine Will North Korean forces bolster Russia's Ukraine war? Danilo Bilek 08/16/2026 August 16, 2026 Intelligence agencies report that North Korea could send up to 50,000 troops to support Russia in its war on Ukraine, though experts doubt this will fundamentally shift the military balance in Moscow’s favor. https://p.dw.com/p/5Itee A museum in North Korea honors soldiers who have fought for Russia Image: KCNA/REUTERS Advertisement In late 2024 , North Korea sent troops to help defend the Kursk region of Russia from Ukraine . International officials estimate that 14,000-15,000 North Korean troops were initially deployed to assist Russia in its war in Ukraine . Now, Ukrainian and international intelligence agencies suspect that North Korea is planning to send an additional 30,000-50,000 troops to Russia . Ukrainian officials have also stated that North Korean ballistic missiles are being fired from Russia. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has raised concerns that North Korea's improved combat and weapons experience could pose a security threat to Ukraine, as well as the Asia-Pacific region. text: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026 Figure caption, Watch: Footage shows huge plumes of smoke rising into the sky in the Moscow region By Dan Johnson ,Â Ukraine correspondent, in Kyiv, Â and Â Tinshui Yeung Published 16 August 2026 At least seven people have been killed in Russia after what officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year. Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39. Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia. Five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov following overnight strikes, its governor said. Officials in Belgorod, which borders Ukraine, said a woman was killed after a civilian bus was struck, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region, according to Governor Andrey Vorobyov. title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Moscow Region, Killing One
text: Ukrainian Drones Strike Moscow Region, Killing One By Reuters Aug. 16, 2026 Telegram/@exilenova_plus Ukrainian drones struck the Moscow region overnight on Sunday in what the provincial governor said was one of the largest attacks to have targeted the region, and which he said had left at least one person dead. In posts on Telegram, Moscow region Governor Andrei Vorobyov said that an 83-year-old man had been killed, with several more injured in Podolsk, where he said a warehouse belonging to Russia 's largest online retailer Wildberries had been struck. He said damage had been caused at several other sites, including at a warehouse in the town of Domodedovo, close to one of Moscow's main airports. title: Suspected Russian Drone Shot Down in Romanian Airspace
text: Suspected Russian Drone Shot Down in Romanian Airspace By Reuters Aug. 16, 2026 Fragments of drones downed on Romanian territory are displayed at the Romanian Foreign Ministry in Bucharest in this handout image released on July 27, 2026. Romanian Foreign Ministry/Handout via REUTERS An F-18 fighter on a NATO air policing mission shot down a drone that illegally breached Romanian national airspace, the fourth unmanned aircraft shot down over the country this year, Romania's Defense Ministry said on Sunday. A spokesperson for NATO's military headquarters, U.S. Army Colonel Martin O'Donnell, said the alliance is constantly on watch and prepared to defend itself from any threat. "Additional details regarding Sunday’s incident remain under investigation, but the drone appears to be Russia n," he said. NATO member Romania shares a 614 kilometers (381 miles) land border with Ukraine and has reported repeated breaches of its airspace by Russia n drones over the past four years, as well as mines floating in the Black Sea across key trade and energy routes. news Trump Rejects New Russia Sanctions at NATO Summit Filled With Big Spending and Big Emotions Read more Romania's Defense Ministry di

title: North Korea’s Kim, Russia’s Putin Reaffirm Ties on Korean Liberation Day
text: North Korea’s Kim, Russia’s Putin Reaffirm Ties on Korean Liberation Day By Reuters Aug. 16, 2026 Kremlin.ru North Korean leader Kim Jong Un reaffirmed the deepening of ties with Russia in a message to President Vladimir Putin as Pyongyang marked the anniversary of independence from Japan's colonial rule, KCNA state news agency said on Sunday. Kim was replying to a message of congratulations from Putin marking Saturday's 81st anniversary of Tokyo's surrender in World War Two. The Russia n leader said the bond was forged as Soviet soldiers fought against Japan and that cooperation would continue "in all the sectors." The North Korean leader expressed hope for the future of ties that had "carried forward the history of common struggle for justice and precious traditions of friendship." Pyongyang and Moscow have grown closer since the reclusive state began deploying troops and weapons to support Russia 's war against Ukraine in what has been Pyongyang's most significant involvement in a war since the 1950s. "The deaths of two women, approximately 60 and 80 years old respectively, have been confirmed," said the emergency services of the Castile and Leon region after the disaster in the small village of Manzanedo de Valdueza. Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39. Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia. title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
text: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026 Figure caption, Watch: Footage shows huge plumes of smoke rising into the sky in the Moscow region By Dan Johnson ,Â Ukraine correspondent, in Kyiv, Â and Â Tinshui Yeung Published 16 August 2026 At least seven people have been killed in Russia after what officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year. Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39. Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia. Five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov following overnight strikes, its governor said. Officials in Belgorod, which borders Ukraine, said a woman was killed after a civilian bus was struck, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region, according to Governor Andrey Vorobyov. text: Более 7 тысяч семей в Севастополе получили региональный материнский капитал С 2020 года региональный материнский капитал получили 7 192 семьи, в этом году — уже 783 семьи. Размер выплаты сегодня составляет 148 677 рублей. Выплату предоставляет Департамент труда и соцзащиты населения. Для многих семей эти деньги становятся реальной помощью в нужный момент. Например, у Юрия и Татьяны Мороз четверо детей. Старшие, Никита и Яна, — уже взрослые, работают. Даша скоро пойдёт в школу, а Саша ещё маленькая. Средства маткапитала пригодились семье для решения текущих семейных вопросов. Региональный материнский капитал — часть мер поддержки семей, которые мы реализуем по нацпроекту «Семья». Претендовать на эту меру поддержки могут гражданки России, которые постоянно живут в Севастополе не меньше года. Среднедушевой доход семьи не должен превышать 2,5 прожиточных минимума на человека (сумма рассчитывается для каждого конкретного случая). Получить выплату можно на второго ребенка, родившегося не ранее 1 января 2019 года. Обратиться за ней можно только после того, как ребенку исполнится один год. 👉 Подробные условия получения регионального маткапитала и перечень необходимых документов смотрите на

title: BBC visits smouldering Kyiv market after Russian strikes
text: BBC visits smouldering Kyiv market after Russian strikes BBC visits smouldering Kyiv market after Russian strikes Close Six people have been injured at a market in the Ukrainian capital Kyiv, as the country was hit by a series of Russian strikes. Five people were reportedly killed across Ukraine, while Russian officials said seven people were killed there, in strikes by Ukraine. The BBC's Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson visited the market, known for selling items like books and posters, as firefighters worked to extinguish hot spots. Follow live coverage. title: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
text: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026 Figure caption, Watch: Footage shows huge plumes of smoke rising into the sky in the Moscow region By Dan Johnson ,Â Ukraine correspondent, in Kyiv, Â and Â Tinshui Yeung Published 16 August 2026 At least seven people have been killed in Russia after what officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year. Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39. Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia. Five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov following overnight strikes, its governor said. Officials in Belgorod, which borders Ukraine, said a woman was killed after a civilian bus was struck, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region, according to Governor Andrey Vorobyov. text: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026 Figure caption, Watch: Footage shows huge plumes of smoke rising into the sky in the Moscow region By Dan Johnson ,Â Ukraine correspondent, in Kyiv, Â and Â Tinshui Yeung Published 16 August 2026 At least seven people have been killed in Russia after what officials called the "largest-scale" attack launched by Ukraine this year. Some 822 drones were used - 600 aiming for Moscow, according to its regional governor who said the Russian capital had suffered "one of the most massive drone attacks in recent memory". A warehouse belonging to Russian online retailer Wildberries was hit. Russian attacks on Ukraine also killed at least seven people and injured more than 39. Russia has intensified missile attacks across Ukraine in recent weeks, with Kyiv also stepping up drone strikes deep inside Russia. Five people died in Russia's south-western region of Rostov following overnight strikes, its governor said. Officials in Belgorod, which borders Ukraine, said a woman was killed after a civilian bus was struck, while an 83-year-old man died in a drone attack in the Moscow region, according to Governor Andrey Vorobyov. title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Moscow Region, Killing One
text: Ukrainian Drones Strike Moscow Region, Killing One By Reuters Aug. 16, 2026 Telegram/@exilenova_plus Ukrainian drones struck the Moscow region overnight on Sunday in what the provincial governor said was one of the largest attacks to have targeted the region, and which he said had left at least one person dead. In posts on Telegram, Moscow region Governor Andrei Vorobyov said that an 83-year-old man had been killed, with several more injured in Podolsk, where he said a warehouse belonging to Russia 's largest online retailer Wildberries had been struck. He said damage had been caused at several other sites, including at a warehouse in the town of Domodedovo, close to one of Moscow's main airports. Romanian Foreign Ministry/Handout via REUTERS An F-18 fighter on a NATO air policing mission shot down a drone that illegally breached Romanian national airspace, the fourth unmanned aircraft shot down over the country this year, Romania's Defense Ministry said on Sunday. A spokesperson for NATO's military headquarters, U.S. Army Colonel Martin O'Donnell, said the alliance is constantly on watch and prepared to defend itself from any threat.
